title: Arizer Mini Whip for filling Balloons
description:
Upgrade your vaping experience with the Arizer Mini Whip, designed for easy filling of balloons with your Arizer Extreme Q or XQ2 vaporizer. This all-glass mini whip ensures a clean, pure vapor path, enhancing flavour and performance. The high-quality glass adapter comes with a glass screen and pre-attached 3” tubing, making setup effortless. Perfectly compatible with Extreme Q glass components, this accessory is a must-have for smooth, efficient vapor delivery.

Elevate your sessions with this premium glass mini whip—crafted for durability and optimal performance. Get yours today!
